renew_seconds.description: Lease renewal interval, shorter than the lease; defaults to 20.

autostart.description: Start the daemon in the background when a command needs it; defaults to true. AGX_NO_AUTOSTART=1 overrides it.

imports.description: Fragments to load, relative to this file: paths, which must exist, or glob patterns, which may match nothing, loaded in lexical order.

daemon.description: Launch lease timing and automatic daemon startup.
